entities.name: Shattering of Madara
entities.description: Month-long fight between Nicol Bolas and a Demonic Leviathan that shrank Madara and created the first temporal rift.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon who defeated a Demonic Leviathan planeswalker with his touch and feasted on its remains.

entities.name: Demonic Leviathan
entities.description: Planeswalker defeated by Nicol Bolas on Dominaria.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Region of Dominaria reduced to a third of its size.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Still-young plane where the fight occurred.

entities.name: Talon Gates
entities.description: All that was left of the leviathan besides blubber.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War long before the Shattering of Madara.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas fights a Demonic Leviathan planeswalker for a month, shrinking Madara and creating the first temporal rift.
events.quote: The fight lasted a month, reduced Madara to a third of its original size, and created the first temporal rift .

events.summary: Bolas defeats the leviathan with his touch and feasts on its remains for over a year.
events.quote: After the battle Bolas feasted on the remains of the leviathan for over a year, absorbing its power in the process.

relations.quote: In the end, the dragon relied upon his touch to defeat his foe.
